whyThisMatters:
Work-exchange platform connecting hosts with travellers who help in exchange for food and accommodation — "Give a little help, stay for free", 2500+ volunteer stays in 100+ countries. Founded Apr 2014, Ireland. 625 active subscriptions; ~2,500 estimated users.

A 12-year-old membership directory in the Workaway/WWOOF lane. Listings are user-generated, travellers pay to contact hosts. Not growing, but still paying 2 dollars–4k every month after a decade.

A host needs an extra pair of hands. A traveller needs a bed. HelpStay has been matching them since 2014, and the company is in Ireland. The stay is food and a room in exchange for the help. The membership is what people pay for. The all-time Stripe total is from many years. The current subscriptions are the recent pace, not that older pile.

People keep paying because the next trip needs another host, and the host needs the next pair of hands.
